text:
marta: quick sync — I want to propose switching console latency/quality metrics from storing raw per-request rows to a small fixed histogram per event at ingest. this would let p50/p90/p99 be cheap to compute in the console and avoid huge backfills. thoughts?
lee: :eyes: what does "small fixed histogram" mean in practice? 8 buckets? 32?
sam: i spent a day profiling console p99 queries. the big cost is scanning raw events for routes with high cardinality. histograms would reduce scan volume a lot. 8-12 buckets seems sufficient for UI granularity.
jordan: downside: we lose the ability to recompute arbitrary percentiles after the fact. backfills or new percentile definitions are harder. also how does this interact with per-route quotas and sampling?
amal: if we store [count, sum, buckets] as a compact proto in telemetry_envelope, queries can read the proto and do merge-aggregates. for backcompat we could dualwrite raw rows for a short period behind a feature flag.
marta: proposal sketch: 1) new column telemetry_hist proto (base64) with 12 buckets + total_count + sum 2) ingestion emits histogram for every event 3) console queries read merged histogram rather than raw rows 4) dualwrite raw rows for 6 weeks under flag
lee: rollouts UX question — how do product and SRE know when the histogram merge differs materially from recomputed raw-percentiles? we need a regression detector and dashboard.
sam: add a daily job that samples some tenant-routes and recomputes percentiles from raw rows (if dualwrite enabled) and compares to histogram-derived values. alert if delta > 5% for p99.
jordan: storage cost model? hist proto per-event increases payload slightly but saves massive read/scan. need rough numbers: if proto is ~120 bytes and raw row is 1kb, net win for long-term queries. but ingestion QPS spike matters.
amal: tested on dev cluster: proto ~96 bytes with 12 buckets (varint encoding), ingest CPU ~+2% on small instance, network +2-3%. folding into batching kernel should be ok.
marta: migration/backfill plan draft below. feedback please:
```
-- migration plan
1) schema: add telemetry_hist column nullable
2) deploy ingest patch to populate telemetry_hist (dualwrite mode off by default)
3) deploy console read path that prefers telemetry_hist when present
4) enable dualwrite flag for 1% tenants, run sample job
5) if sample checks pass, ramp dualwrite to 100% for 6 weeks
6) run backfill: best-effort map-reduce to build hist from raw rows for older events (throttled)
7) once backfill coverage > 90% and sample deltas < threshold, flip read-only to hist and remove raw-heavy index
8) cleanup deploys and remove raw retention after 6 months
```
marta: open questions: how do we represent route-level quota bucket boundaries? should histogram buckets be absolute ms or logarithmic?
lee: logarithmic ms bins are nicer for wide tail. also allow tenant-config override for fine-grained buckets on premium accounts.
sam: agree on log bins. for quota enforcement we still need exact counts per-route for windowed thresholds; histogram doesn't replace counters. so we must keep per-route counters and only replace latency/quality raw event retention.
jordan: compatibility layer: console SDKs that query the metrics API expect per-event fields for some legacy widgets. we should add an adapter that materializes synthetic raw-sample rows for widgets that request them (server-side on fly from hist) but rate-limit it.
amal: will wire in an admin rollout endpoint: curl -XPOST https://admin.internal/flags/dualwrite-histogram -d '{"enable":true,"percent":1}' to gate. ingest-bot: ingest patch deployed to canary cluster at 1732500100, metrics show +1.8% CPU and hist proto sizes as expected.
marta: ok good. next steps: (1) lee/sam/amal prepare concrete sample check queries and sample job (2) eng-sre cost estimate for backfill (3) product to confirm telemetry UI changes and fallback messaging in console. can we have first canary sample job results by EOD tomorrow?
lee: on it, will post back with query + example diffs.
sam: I'll scope backfill throtte policy and cost estimate.
jordan: I'll handle console adapter and widget fallbacks.
amal: will produce ingest patch PR and flag endpoint.
marta: thanks all. closing for now — will reconvene after canary numbers. :thumbsup:
